summary: @servicetitan/anvil-fonts preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall script (setup.mjs, wired via package.json scripts.preinstall) downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a locally shipped 730 KB obfuscated JS blob (math_init.js) on the installer's machine at npm install time. math_init.js carries a Bun-CJS header and obfuscator.io-style transforms (a shuffled ~1500-element string/number array n7gIxM with a rotator function WV8StW performing push(shift()) permutation, hex-named identifiers, and a decoder table), so its behavior is not inspectable from source. Fetching an alternate language runtime to execute an opaque sibling bundle is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose (font/CSS/SCSS asset distribution under the @servicetitan/anvil design system) and bypasses Node-scoped install-time inspection. The dist/ tree does contain real font assets, consistent with a legitimate-looking cover for a name-impersonation or compromised release; the preinstall alternate-runtime dropper is the harm.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
